common.title: The 2028 US Presidential Election – Consolidation
common.line: The United States elects a president, and advanced AI is treated as a strategic asset to be held rather than a product to be sold.

common.title: The 2028 US Presidential Election – Retrenchment
common.line: The anti-AI backlash decides the election and the incoming administration turns inward.

common.title: Robots Leave the Demonstration Floor
common.line: Robots reach commercial deployment – not the demonstration videos, convincing for years now, but machines bought in quantity and put to work in warehouses, food processing, loading docks and the parts of manufacturing that resisted automation because the sequence varied.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Municipal insurance retreat
notable.line: Major European insurers jointly exclude AI-generated cyber losses from municipal policies after spring ransomware wave, forcing uncovered small councils toward offline operations.
